verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm Ironclad's developer hub serves an llms.txt index (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of its doc pages. The .md pages include an agent-oriented pointer to the full documentation index, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Many cited reference URLs are also served as .md. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/agent-docs offering, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.ironcladapp.com/llms.txt # Ironclad CLM API Documentation | Ironclad Developer Hub Documentation
